title: A consumer rejects a manifest carrying reading history rather than ignoring the extra member
rationale: The schema rejecting the document is worth nothing if the consumer shrugs and reads the rest. A consumer that tolerates the member becomes the component that carries reading history onward into whatever it produces.

requirement.text: Engines MUST validate manifests against the schema before publishing or exporting; the schema’s additionalProperties: false constraints make most violations mechanically detectable.
